Acceptance criteria: Given a customer and in-stock products, When I save an order with line items, Then the order and every line item are stored, and the same product cannot appear twice on one order.
Given an order, When I add a line item with quantity 0 or less, Then the system rejects it.
Given an order, When I set a status other than Placed, Picked, Shipped, Delivered or Cancelled, Then the system rejects it.
Given an existing product code, When I add another product with the same code, Then the system rejects it.
Given a line item for a product that does not exist, When I save it, Then the system rejects it.
Given 35 units on hand, When I pick 500, Then the pick is rejected and stock stays at 35 and the shortfall is shown.
Given an order marked Shipped or Delivered, When I save it without a ship date, Then the system rejects it.
Given 60 units on hand, When I pick 12, Then on-hand becomes 48.
Given stock levels, When I open the reorder list, Then it shows every product at or below its reorder point, with supplier and lead time, largest shortfall first.
Given a product above its reorder point, When a pick brings it to the reorder point, Then it appears on the next list.
Given orders in any status, When I run the report, Then cancelled orders are excluded and margin percent equals (price minus cost) divided by price, to one decimal.
Given orders with ship dates, When I run the report, Then only shipped or delivered orders are counted, with order count and average days per region.
